header.et0: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (power_prep.et0_pm), G = 0; ea = sat_vp(tdew); rs MJ/m2/day; lat from power_prep.LAT, elev from the POWER header; csv value is rounded to 2 dp.
header.heat_index: RH at Tmax from dew point (power_prep.rh_at_tmax), NWS heat index in deg C from the 1-dp RH; PAGASA bands none<27, caution<33, extreme_caution<42, danger<52, extreme_danger.
header.zscores: spei/robust_z use leave-one-year-out `ref` for the same calendar month; D = 0.5 (-spei - z_sm), -spei if z_sm undefined; label normal/bantay/delikado.
